newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Crowds gather at Albania mourning ceremony.
newsitem.headline: Crowds gather at Albania mourning ceremony.

text.p: About 3,000 Albanians bearing bouquets of flowers and chanting "Peace, peace" gathered in Tirana's central square on Sunday to mourn more than 100 people killed in unrest in the Balkan country.
Police aboard vans and a single armoured vehicle patrolled Skanderbeg Square as the crowd clapped hands and staged a brief march.
Some chanted "Hand in the Arms," a reference to appeals for gunmen who have been rampaging through Albanian towns to give up their weapons.
Albania's flag, a double-headed black eagle on a red background, stood at half mast by a mounted statue of 15th century national hero Gjergj Kastriot Skanderbeg.
Violence erupted through southern Albania in January over the collapse of fraudulent investment schemes.
It spread to most of the country in recent weeks, turning into a lawless revolt against President Sali Berisha.
At least 20 people have died in Tirana during two days of shooting this week.
